title: Tofu kimchi rice bowl
summary: Tofu kimchi rice bowl is a japanese dinner built around smoked tofu and kimchi, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice smoked tofu and kimchi before the pan is hot. Tofu kimchi rice bowl is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry smoked tofu until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add kimchi and basmati rice, return smoked tofu, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Tofu kimchi rice bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
